d: Position: Art Director – Creative Design, Photography, Video & AI
MGB Media is looking for a highly creative, hands-on, and technically skilled Art Director to join our team in Muscat.

We are seeking a versatile creative professional who can independently handle graphic design, photography, videography, video editing, motion graphics, and AI-powered content creation, while maintaining exceptional visual quality across all projects.
The ideal candidate must be equally comfortable developing creative concepts and executing them personally, from initial idea to final delivery.
Creative Direction: Develop innovative visual concepts, campaign identities, storyboards, and creative content for digital, print, outdoor advertising, and events.
Graphic Design: Design high-quality social media creatives, advertising campaigns, branding materials, presentations, and marketing assets.
Photography: Plan, shoot, direct, and professionally edit commercial, product, architectural, corporate, and event photography.
Videography: Handle professional video production, including camera operation, lighting, composition, and creative shooting techniques.
Video Editing & Motion Graphics: Produce engaging promotional videos, reels, animations, motion graphics, and cinematic content.
Adobe Creative Cloud: Demonstrate advanced proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Lightroom, InDesign, and other relevant Adobe applications.

AI Creative Tools: Utilize AI-powered platforms such as Midjourney, Runway, Higgsfield, Adobe Firefly, ChatGPT, and other emerging AI tools for image generation, video production, creative enhancement, and workflow optimization.
Brand Consistency: Ensure all creative outputs align with brand guidelines, campaign objectives, and client expectations.
Production Management: Manage creative projects from concept development through production, revisions, and final delivery.
Creative Innovation: Continuously explore new technologies, visual trends, AI applications, and creative production techniques.
Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in creative design, advertising, or media production.
Strong portfolio demonstrating graphic design, photography, videography, video editing, and motion graphics.
Advanced knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud applications.
Proven practical experience using AI tools for professional creative production.
Strong understanding of visual storytelling, lighting, composition, typography, branding, and art direction.
Ability to independently execute creative projects from concept to completion.
Experience producing content for social media, digital advertising, outdoor media, and commercial campaigns.
Excellent attention to detail, creativity, and time management.
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines.
Must currently reside in Muscat, Oman.
